title: Corrective Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.15596v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are theoretically well-suited for iterative refinement due to their non-causal structure, off-the-shelf masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) often fail to reliably revise incorrect tokens in practice. The key challenge is that the model cannot tell correct from erroneous visible tokens: standard MDLM training supervises only masked positions, undermining confidence-guided refinement. We study corrective behavior in DLMs, the ability to assign lower confidence to incorrect tokens and iteratively refine them while preserving correct content. Under matched compute and data, we show that conventional masked-diffusion fine-tuning induces much less of this capability than a correction-oriented post-training principle that explicitly supervises visible corrupted tokens, which enables discriminative confidence and targeted refinement. translated_abstract: 尽管扩散语言模型凭借其非因果结构在理论上非常适合迭代精炼，但现成的掩码扩散语言模型在实践中往往无法可靠地修正错误的词元。关键挑战在于模型无法区分可见词元中的正确与错误：标准的掩码扩散语言模型训练仅对被掩码的位置进行监督，从而削弱了基于置信度引导的精炼能力。我们研究了扩散语言模型中的纠错行为，即为错误词元赋予较低置信度并在保留正确内容的同时对其进行迭代精炼的能力。在相同的计算量和数据条件下，我们表明，传统的掩码扩散微调所诱导的这种纠错能力远低于一种面向纠错的后训练原则，后者显式地对可见的被破坏词元进行监督，从而实现有区分力的置信度和针对性的精炼。我们进一步发现，同时对干净的可见词元进行监督，正如……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向纠错的后训练原则，通过显式监督可见的损坏词元，使掩码扩散语言模型能够对错误词元给出低置信度并进行有针对性的迭代修正，同时保留正确内容，其效果显著优于传统的掩码扩散微调。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a correction-oriented post-training principle that explicitly supervises visible corrupted tokens, enabling masked diffusion language models to assign discriminative confidence to erroneous tokens and iteratively refine them while preserving correct content, far outperforming conventional masked-diffusion fine-tuning.
